Gauge.Name: STOVL Window Control
Gauge.Comment:
This gauge controls the STOVL 2D-window in Dino Catteneo's F35-A/B/C panel.cfg. At aircraft initialisation, this window (with Ident 10090) is opened only when (L:F35Model,enum) is set to 1; hence loading the STOVL gauges only for the F35-B.
V1.1: - Checks if the ***_Function gauge is loaded, to assure the window is opened and preventing unnecessary (timer-based) WindowOpen commands.
